name: iweather-card
description: A forecast card for Home Assistant, with live scenery, hourly conditions, precipitation and wind, and a 10-day outlook.

scripts.lint: biome lint --error-on-warnings && oxlint --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config && ! grep -rnE '(oxlint|eslint)-disable|biome-ignore' src test e2e scripts demo *.ts && node scripts/names.ts
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && biome format && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm compat && pnpm e2e
scripts.check:quick: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && biome format && pnpm test:changed
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config blame.ignoreRevsFile .git-blame-ignore-revs
